%% ============================================================================
%% main-ieee.tex -- IEEE shell (IEEEtran, conference, 10 pt), the page format of
%% ISCA 2026 and HPCA 2027.  Kept buildable alongside main-acm.tex; the text, the
%% macros, the author list and the bibliography are the same files.
%% Build with ./build.sh (see README-build.md); do not edit the text here.
%% ============================================================================
\input{preamble/switches}
\PaperRequireVenue{none,isca26,hpca27}        % the venues this shell implements

\documentclass[10pt,conference]{IEEEtran}
\IEEEoverridecommandlockouts                  % lets the share build attach a note to the title
\usepackage{cite}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsfonts}
\usepackage{textcomp}
\PassOptionsToPackage{hyphens}{url}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\pdfpagewidth=8.5in \pdfpageheight=11in       % US Letter, as in the venue templates
\input{preamble/common}
\input{preamble/authors-ieee}
\renewcommand{\figrefname}{Fig.}              % IEEE wording for cross references

\begin{document}
\hypersetup{pdftitle={\PaperTitlePDF}}
\title{\PaperTitle\ifPaperNotice\thanks{\PaperNoticeText}\fi}
\ifPaperBanner   % submit mode only: the author block is the venue's banner
  \PaperIfVenue{isca26}{\author{\normalsize{ISCA 2026 Submission
      \textbf{\#\PaperSubmissionID} -- Confidential Draft -- Do NOT Distribute!!}}}{}
  \PaperIfVenue{hpca27}{\author{\IEEEauthorblockN{\normalsize{HPCA 2027 Submission
      \textbf{\#\PaperSubmissionID}}} \\ \IEEEauthorblockA{Confidential Draft \\ Do NOT Distribute!!}}}{}
\else
  \ifPaperAnon
    \author{Anonymous Author(s)}              % authors.tex is not read at all
  \else
    \input{authors}
    \PaperEmitAuthors
  \fi
\fi
\maketitle
\thispagestyle{plain}\pagestyle{plain}        % page numbers, as the venue templates require

\begin{abstract}
\input{sections/00-abstract}
\end{abstract}
\suppressfloats[t]                            % no figure above the abstract in the first column

\input{body}

% ---- acknowledgments and AI-use statement ------------------------------------------
\ifPaperAcks
  \section*{Acknowledgment}
  \input{backmatter/acks}
  \ifPaperAIUse\par\input{backmatter/ai-use}\fi
\else
  \ifPaperAIUse
    % ISCA 2026 wants the statement in the acknowledgments (inside the page limit);
    % HPCA 2027 wants it in an appendix after the references (see below)
    \PaperIfVenue{hpca27}{}{\section*{Acknowledgment}\input{backmatter/ai-use}}
  \fi
\fi

\bibliographystyle{IEEEtranS}
\ifPaperNociteAll\nocite{*}\fi
\bibliography{refs}

\newif\ifPaperIEEEAppendices \PaperIEEEAppendicesfalse
\ifPaperAppendix\PaperIEEEAppendicestrue\fi
\ifPaperAIUse\ifPaperAcks\else\PaperIfVenue{hpca27}{\PaperIEEEAppendicestrue}{}\fi\fi
\ifPaperIEEEAppendices
  \appendices
  \ifPaperAIUse\ifPaperAcks\else\PaperIfVenue{hpca27}{\section{AI use}\input{backmatter/ai-use}}{}\fi\fi
  \ifPaperAppendix\input{backmatter/appendix}\fi
\fi
\PrintTBDIndex
\end{document}
